aiSystems.name: Production RAG
aiSystems.summary: A production-shaped retrieval system that combines dense and sparse search, reranks candidates, and returns grounded answers with resolvable citations—or refuses.

evidence.label: Grounded answers, refusal, and free demo — SHIP

aiSystems.name: Agentic Research
aiSystems.summary: A bounded plan → retrieve → critique research loop with tools, explicit budgets, API/CLI/UI surfaces, cited synthesis, and deterministic traces.

evidence.label: API, CLI, UI, tools, and stop contracts — SHIP

aiSystems.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
aiSystems.summary: An orchestrator and specialist agents with explicit handoffs, global budgets, failure isolation, and auditable multi-agent timelines.

evidence.label: Bounded roles, handoffs, API/CLI, and degraded mode — SHIP
12-task offline routing evaluation contract — a routing contract, not a claim that agents beat one model

aiSystems.name: RepoMind
aiSystems.summary: Repository intelligence built around safe repository walking, AST-aware chunks, symbol retrieval, fixture-backed evaluation, and precise path:line citations.

evidence.label: AST chunks, code Q&A, CLI, and claim boundary — SHIP
14-question fixture evaluation contract — citation plumbing on a fixture, not SOTA over arbitrary repositories

aiSystems.name: AI Platform
aiSystems.summary: A service gateway for the portfolio with API-key authentication, per-key rate limits, request-ID propagation, aggregate health, and compose-based operations.

evidence.label: Open health, gateway contracts, and release boundary — SHIP
Free path is the gateway only: it does not run P1–P4 for the visitor
Upstream URLs are empty in CI, so the four services report unconfigured
The dev-local demo key is a public fixture, not a credential
Rate limiting is an in-process fixed window on one instance, not a distributed limiter

capabilities.title: AI systems

capabilities.title: Backend & platform
capabilities.description: Typed APIs and operational seams across Python and Rust services.

capabilities.title: Product surfaces
capabilities.description: One engineering language per surface when that is the honest product trade-off.

capabilities.title: Delivery & trust
capabilities.description: Quality gates, explicit failure modes, and evidence that survives outside the author's laptop.

principles.title: Evidence over adjectives
principles.copy: A capability is linked to code, a test, a release, or a runnable path. Planned work stays visibly planned.

principles.title: Failure is a product state
principles.copy: Refusal, degradation, budget exhaustion, and dependency failure are modeled explicitly instead of hidden behind a successful response.

principles.title: Free path first
principles.copy: Core demos run without credentials or billed calls, so reviewers can inspect the whole system rather than trust screenshots.
